work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Brief CXXVI commissions the archbishop of Genoa to transfer S. Nicolò in Carbonara from the Discalced Augustinians to the Brothers of the Christian Schools at the king of Sardinia’s request; LF27900 → LF27905 across running title LF27902; LF27966 → LF27975 across own provenance LF27969 and running title LF27972; complete 24 January 1837 closing. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF27850–27850; the source closing at LF27988–27991 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima quarta ianuarii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo septimo, pontificatus Nostri anno sexto. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
